'''Z-100 group''' was a group of [[Muurian transport]]s that served the [[Zaarin coup forces|splinter government]] [[Zaarin's fleet|fleet]] of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] during the [[Zaarin insurrection]]. It was present at the [[Battle of To-phalion Base]].
